cohort: 204 children with T1DM and 204 age- and sex-matched controls in Assiut, Egypt
finding: The risk for T1DM was significantly higher among rural residents, those with a parental history of T1DM, those born through cesarean section, and those who had early introduction of cow milk in the first year of life.
mod_finding: Birth through cesarean section was associated with a significantly higher risk of T1DM (aOR = 2.13, 95% CI: 1.09-5.03).
